purpose: Fill from physical TableCam captures and a TCP-held calibration reference. Values are base-frame metres except pixels.

procedure: Place the same identifiable reference point at each location or hold it with the calibrated TCP.
Capture a native-resolution TableCam image with no crop or resize.
Record the reference centre pixel and its measured base-frame feature position.
Use the feature's actual height as feature_plane_base_z_m; do not substitute the table plane for a raised target.
